Prevention: When transplanting, check for possible thrips infestation and use pest-free planting material.
Avoid planting near existing grain fields if possible, because thrips may migrate to your fields when the grain senesces.
Apply balanced crop nutrition and avoid overuse of nitrogen to promote plant vigour.
Use reflective or white plastic mulch.
Encourage predator activities by avoiding the use of broad- spectrum insecticides.
Monitoring: Scout field regularly on all parts of the plant for the presence of thrips and their damage symptoms (scars).
Use blue or white sticky trap or pan traps for monitoring the adult population.
Observe field borders where thrips numbers are usually high.
Action thresholds depend on season but you may consider treating when more than 30 thrips are found per plant across the plot.
Direct Control: Spray neem oil products (For 1% azadirachtin ~30ml/15L; 0.3% azadirachtin ~75ml/15L).

Restrictions: Rotate chemical use (change chemical regularly) to avoid the build-up of resistance.

Toxic to aquatic organisms, avoid using near waterways.
